items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: So, Stadbury and I sat on that, far from it, and Stadbury walks over to Sidney

ctx.x: Sidney Bourgeois hit his friend? Oh, he was a terrific puncher. When he was a professor, when he got to drinking, he was a tough man. He was really tough. And if he hit you one time, he was going. He was a tough puncher. Take two, three men to take care of him, the guy he's tough.
So, Stadbury and I sat on that, far from it, and Stadbury walks over to Sidney, and said, don't you ever hit me. Stadbury can fight. I got a group of friends.
You know something? Maybe you might not be mentioning names because they might sue you. You might have some relatives living here.
